description: Configuration loading preserves include order and check order while rendering disabled checks and challenge overrides.

input.yaml:
---
challenge: Enter
includes:
  - alpha
  - beta
  - alpha
version: 9.9.9
checks:
- from: alpha
  test: literal text
  method: Contains
  enable: false
  challenge: Yes
  description: "disabled alpha"
- from: beta
  test: ^sudo
  method: StartWith
  enable: true
  challenge: Math
  description: "beta line one\nline two"

cases.expected_output:
challenge=Enter
includes=alpha,beta,alpha
check_count=2
check=alpha|Contains|false|Yes|disabled alpha
check=beta|StartWith|true|Math|beta line one\nline two
